verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only time-based scheduled recurring actions (e.g., a daily news digest) and a Daily Brief. Neither is a user-defined rule that fires actions automatically when an event occurs, such as a new email or file change, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The axis applies to an AI assistant, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: You can make Gemini a part of your daily, weekly, and monthly routines by scheduling recurring actions.
